Confirmed and candidate HVSs are summarized in Table 2, though the origin of these HVSs is still uncertain (Han et al. 2025).

values.condition: Galactocentric velocity V_GC listed for S5-HVS 1 in Table 2.

notes: US 708, LAMOST-HVS 1, and S5-HVS 1 are included as follow-up HVSs: Table 2 compiles them as confirmed/candidate HVSs from prior studies and gives their Galactocentric velocities (T:p12-b0), and the text studies the HVS sample in connection with the Hills mechanism (T:p10-b5). The paper does not report an independent present-day escape-speed calculation; HVS status is interpreted under the established field meaning of a Galactic-unbound star. The collective Table 2 entries “SDSS HVSs” and “Marchetti2022 sample” do not provide individual member identifiers in the supplied material, so they were not expanded into individual star entries (T:p12-b0).

US 708: Table 2 (T:p12-b0, I:p12-b0) reports only the Galactocentric velocity V_GC ≈ 750 km/s for US 708; no equatorial coordinates, distance, parallax, proper motion, or radial velocity is given. The listed galactocentric velocity is treated as the star's total Galactic-frame speed.

LAMOST-HVS 1: Target star LAMOST-HVS 1 appears only in Table 2 (p12-b0, confirmed/candidate HVSs; image I:p12-b0), which lists spectral type (B-type), the galactocentric velocity V_GC ~ 550 km/s, and the reference Zheng et al. (2014). No position, distance, parallax, proper motion, or line-of-sight velocity is reported for this star, so only V_GC is extracted. The paper's usage (T:p10-b5) indicates V_GC is the star's current total velocity relative to the Galaxy (Galactic rest frame), decelerated from its ejection velocity v_ej; it is therefore recorded as galactic_rest_frame_velocity. The value is explicitly approximate ("~ 550"), so the reported central value 550 km/s is retained with that qualification.

S5-HVS 1: S5-HVS 1 appears in Table 2 with a Galactocentric velocity V_GC ~ 1700 km/s. The paper also states v_ej(S5-HVS1) ≈ 2×10^3 km s^-1 in T:p10-b5, but this is an ejection velocity, not one of the requested quantities, so it is not recorded.
